# Element library

Icons usable as `{ "type": "icon", "icon": "<name>" }`. Every icon is drawn stroke by stroke on a 24×24 grid and scaled to `size`.

| Name | What it shows / use it for | Tags |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | A single person: end user, customer, developer | people |
| `users` | A group of people: team, audience, many users | people |
| `laptop` | Laptop: developer machine, desktop client | device, client |
| `phone` | Mobile phone: mobile app, mobile client | device, client |
| `browser` | Browser window: web app, frontend | client, app |
| `server` | Server rack: backend, API server, host | infra |
| `database` | Database: SQL/NoSQL store, persistence | infra, data |
| `cloud` | Cloud: cloud provider, internet, external service | infra |
| `queue` | Stacked layers: queue, stack, layered system | infra, data |

| `chatbot` | Chat bubble with a face: chatbot, assistant | ai, app |
